audit_question: Can each critical gate be reproduced deterministically from the frozen prereg (plus pre-existing project authority)?

gates.note: funding-cashflow leg is separately frozen and subtracted; independence verified in ARC01_FUNDING_ACCOUNTING_AUDIT.json

residual_ambiguity: the sample standard deviation convention (ddof) inside 'per-trade Sharpe' is not restated in the gates file
'window_days' is not explicitly disambiguated (common-window span vs trade span)

authority_evidence.convention: _sharpe uses ddof = 1 (n-1) and annualizes by mean/std * sqrt(periods_per_year); with periods_per_year = trades_per_year this is exactly the frozen G5 formula

gates.boundary_sensitivity: ddof = 1 vs 0 shifts the statistic by ~sqrt(N/(N-1)) ~ 0.4% at the frozen minimum N = 120; only a result inside ~[0.498, 0.502] could be moved across the 0.50 threshold

gates.formula_frozen: bootstrap 95% CI lower bound of the MEAN net trade return (statistic stated explicitly, not implied)

authority_evidence.convention: percentile method with lower_idx = floor(0.025 * R); seeded random.Random(seed)

gates.boundary_sensitivity: percentile vs interpolation differ by < one order statistic at R=10000; the operative criterion (CI lower > 0) is additionally cross-checked by the frozen P(mean > 0) formulation

gates.formula_frozen: sign-flip permutation p-value of the MEAN net trade return (statistic stated explicitly)

authority_evidence.convention: one-sided upper tail: exceed counts null statistics >= observed; p_value = exceed / permutations; alpha = 0.05
authority_evidence.project_precedent: docs/external-audit-01/oi-full-history-02/H6_SPEC_V2.json specifies its own permutation gate with identical granularity ('sign-flip permutation on hourly trade returns, 10,000 draws, fixed seed 20260911') and was accepted as a frozen prereg in this repository; ARC-01 is at least as specific

gates.boundary_sensitivity: sidedness is a ~2x factor, resolved to one-sided by the pre-existing project module and by the directional (positive-expectancy) hypothesis; the < vs <= boundary at exactly p = 0.05 is a single-draw band at 10,000 draws

gates.formula_frozen: net expectancy by chronological halves and quartiles
residual_ambiguity: the note states splits are computed on the TRADE TIMELINE (equal-count), which is the operative clarification over the phrase 'of the common window'

authority_evidence.note_text: split boundaries are computed on the trade timeline, chronological, frozen before discovery

residual_ambiguity: a trade's calendar-month attribution (entry-instant vs exit-instant) is not stated
gates.denominator_behavior_when_total_le_zero: explicitly defined (share only computed when total_net_PnL > 0); total <= 0 already implies G2 failure
gates.single_trade_share_definition: component_net_PnL / total_net_PnL; max over trades (negative components cannot be the max)
gates.boundary_sensitivity: month attribution affects only trades whose entry and exit fall in different calendar months, and only matters if a month share sits within one trade of the 40% bound

ex_funding_gate_independence.detail: the return definition freezes NET = GROSS_PRICE_LEG + FUNDING_CASHFLOW - COST; the ex-funding statistic removes the FUNDING_CASHFLOW term and is therefore an independent quantity; see ARC01_FUNDING_ACCOUNTING_AUDIT.json

verdict.reason: Every critical gate freezes its metric, threshold, statistic, resample/draw count and seed. The only unstated items are standard estimator conventions that the repository's sole, pre-prereg statistical implementation pins (ddof=1; percentile bootstrap index; one-sided sign-flip), and the project's own accepted H6 prereg used identical granularity. No gate semantics are outcome-ambiguous outside narrow or project-convention-resolved bands.
non_blocking_limitations: The prereg does not bind the statistical module by hash; exact bit-for-bit reproduction of G5/G6/G7 requires using src/trading_bot/backtesting/stat_validation.py conventions.
G10 calendar-month attribution (entry vs exit) is not disambiguated.
